task: Index and search documents through a local API
packaging_note: Use the loopback HTTP API and store indexed documents in a named volume.
licence: Upstream declares MIT for its community code and BUSL-1.1 for Enterprise Edition components. The Dokploy template retains its own licence in TEMPLATE-LICENSE.

access.why: The service uses a container network to serve its local address.

known_issues: The loopback API accepts reads and writes from programs on this computer without a key.

x-display.title: Search your documents with an API
x-display.summary: Run a local search API that your apps can add documents to and query.
x-display.description: Use this as the search component of another app or workflow. Your software supplies the documents and sends search requests; the service stays running to answer them. It is not a browser-based file manager and does not automatically index your computer.
